title: feuilleea californica
intro: Feuilleea californica, commonly known as California peppergrass, is a type of flowering plant native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Feuilleea californica include anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic effects, which can help to alleviate coughs and other respiratory symptoms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
